text:
```(setq s1
      (concat
       (propertize "foo" 'value "baz1" :number 1)
       (propertize "bar" 'value "baz2" :number 4)
       (propertize "1" 'value "baz3")))
;;=> #("foobar1" 0 3 (value "baz1" :number 1) 3 6 (value "baz2" :number 4) 6 7 (value "baz3"))

(ppp-list
 (with-temp-buffer
   (insert s1)
   (goto-char (point-min))
   (let (res)
     (while (not (eobp))
       (let ((plist (text-properties-at (point)))
             (next-change
              (or (next-property-change (point) (current-buffer))
                  (point-max))))
         (push `(,(buffer-substring-no-properties (point) next-change)
                 (,(point) . ,next-change)
                 ,plist)
               res)
         (goto-char next-change)))
     (nreverse res))))
;;=> (("foo"
;;     (1 . 4)
;;     (:number 1 value "baz1"))
;;    ("bar"
;;     (4 . 7)
;;     (:number 4 value "baz2"))
;;    ("1"
;;     (7 . 8)
;;     (value "baz3")))```
